objective: Repair the independently observed M241 fixed-one-cycle response and overflow-success bugs without restoring accumulator forwarding or M149.

required_findings: M249-P1-04 overflow still handshakes successful commit
M249-P1-05 loader payload not bound to returned data

weight_macro_protocol.request: valid/ready plus bank mask, address, sequence, operator, partition, window, weight_epoch, payload_id, descriptor order, source and half
weight_macro_protocol.response: valid/ready plus the complete request identity and signed INT8 data
weight_macro_protocol.response_latency: elastic; exact VCS must pass fixed 1, 2 and 3 cycles plus randomized 1-to-3 cycles and launch stalls
weight_macro_protocol.stale_response_policy: ready remains low, response is never consumed, protocol fault latches until reset

accumulator_macro_protocol.request: valid/ready plus bank mask, dense address, sequence, window, weight_epoch, payload_id and descriptor order
accumulator_macro_protocol.response: valid/ready plus the complete request identity and Acc19 data
accumulator_macro_protocol.response_latency: elastic; exact VCS must pass fixed 1, 2 and 3 cycles plus randomized 1-to-3 cycles and launch stalls
accumulator_macro_protocol.stale_response_policy: ready remains low, response is never consumed, protocol fault latches until reset

repair.loader_binding: context open requires operator, partition, weight_epoch and payload_id to match an explicit valid loader binding
repair.identity: window, checkpoint epoch and payload identity are carried through context, cache, requests, responses and retirement

overflow.accepted_younger_policy: count and discard s0/s1 tokens atomically; pulse context_abort after abort acceptance

required_exact_vcs.source_identity: exact SHA preflight including the M249 independent-review seal

claim_boundary: M241r2 may claim an 8-lane standalone elastic tagged protocol repair over the same 126-descriptor real checkpoint subset. Four latency modes and directed response stalls must be exact in VCS, stale weight/accumulator responses must never be consumed, and overflow must retire only through abort with two accepted younger tokens discarded. The 9.0x weight-read-work ratio and M238 1.687018x target remain non-cycle, non-physical and non-system claims.
